cases.name: savepoint
cases.note: savepoints: currently not rejected by the ruleset
steps: SAVEPOINT baseline_sp

cases.name: create_view
cases.note: views: currently not rejected by the ruleset
steps: CREATE VIEW baseline_v AS SELECT 1 AS x

cases.name: create_sequence
cases.note: sequences: currently not rejected by the ruleset
steps: CREATE SEQUENCE baseline_seq

observations.message: CREATE SEQUENCE is not supported without an explicit cache size. please define CACHE greater than or equal to 65536 or equal to 1

cases.name: create_sequence_cached
cases.note: sequences with high CACHE may be allowed
steps: CREATE SEQUENCE baseline_seq2 CACHE 65536

cases.name: create_schema
steps: CREATE SCHEMA baseline_schema

cases.name: create_function_plpgsql
cases.note: confirm non-sql function languages are refused
steps: CREATE FUNCTION baseline_plpgsql() RETURNS int LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN 1; END $$

observations.message: CREATE FUNCTION with language plpgsql not supported

cases.name: identity_column_cached
cases.note: confirm identity with a large CACHE is allowed
steps: CREATE TABLE baseline_identity_cached (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY (CACHE 65536) PRIMARY KEY, value text)

cases.name: identity_integer
cases.note: an integer identity column: refused, naming the type?
steps: CREATE TABLE baseline_identity_int (id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (CACHE 1) PRIMARY KEY)

observations.message: datatype integer not supported, identity column type must be bigint

cases.name: identity_smallint
cases.note: confirm the restriction is to bigint rather than to integer alone
steps: CREATE TABLE baseline_identity_small (id smallint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (CACHE 1) PRIMARY KEY)

observations.message: datatype smallint not supported, identity column type must be bigint

cases.name: identity_bigint_by_default
cases.note: the form the restriction leaves, with the smallest allowed CACHE
steps: CREATE TABLE baseline_identity_big (id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (CACHE 1) PRIMARY KEY)

cases.name: alter_add_pk_constraint
cases.note: add a primary key to a table that has none
steps: ALTER TABLE baseline_alter_pkadd ADD CONSTRAINT baseline_pkadd_pk PRIMARY KEY (id)

observations.message: unsupported ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT statement

cases.name: alter_add_unique_constraint
cases.note: add a unique constraint without an index to adopt
steps: ALTER TABLE baseline_alter_pkadd ADD CONSTRAINT baseline_pkadd_uq UNIQUE (v)

observations.message: unsupported ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT statement

cases.name: q_row_constructor
cases.note: a row value built in the projection
steps: SELECT ROW(1, 'a')

cases.name: q_row_comparison
steps: SELECT ROW(1, 'a') = ROW(1, 'a') AS same

cases.name: q_whole_row_reference
cases.note: a table referenced as a whole row, which is a composite of its rowtype
steps: SELECT baseline_parent FROM baseline_parent LIMIT 1

cases.name: q_whole_row_in_subquery
cases.note: the shape an ORM generates for a nested projection
steps: SELECT (SELECT p FROM baseline_parent p WHERE p.id = c.id) AS whole FROM baseline_parent c LIMIT 1

cases.name: alter_add_identity_integer
cases.note: is an integer identity column refused when ALTER TABLE adds one?
steps: ALTER TABLE baseline_alter ADD COLUMN seq integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (CACHE 1)

observations.message: ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN with constraint not supported

cases.name: create_sequence_cache_one
steps: CREATE SEQUENCE baseline_seq_one CACHE 1

cases.name: rollback_to_savepoint
steps: ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT baseline_sp

cases.name: set_transaction_repeatable_read
cases.note: confirm SET TRANSACTION is refused even for the supported level
steps: SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ

cases.name: set_default_isolation
steps: SET default_transaction_isolation = 'repeatable read'
